title: Observability: tier status (14 nodes + 2 VRRP VIP holders)
description: Runs `nexus status observability`. One table over the 14 LGTM nodes (prom/loki/tempo/grafana/grafana-pg/otel) with each service active-state and the live VRRP VIP holders folded into the grafana / grafana-pg role labels.

observe.what: 14-row table; grafana/grafana-pg nodes show vip-master vs backup; all services alive

whatProves: ObservabilityAdapter.GetStatusAsync probes each service unit over SSH and resolves the two VRRP VIP holders (.184/.185) dynamically (nopreempt — the holder drifts).
